If I had to start my Data Engineering journey from scratch,

1. Learn SQL 

>Basics(GeeksforGeeks) | 🔗https://lnkd.in/giDNAFyV
>Window's function(Ashutosh Kumar) | 🔗https://lnkd.in/gJ8PVugX

Let me know if you'd like to add more to the list or have any suggestions!
